subject: Important Update: Account Security
body: Dear valued customer, We are writing to inform you about an important update regarding the security of your account. As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance security measures, we have implemented additional layers of protection to safeguard your personal information. Please take a moment to review your account settings and ensure that your contact details are up to date. If you have any concerns or require assistance, do not hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services. Best regards, Security Team
